source_runtime.source_comment_semantics: num_workers controls data-loader performance and explicitly increases memory/CPU usage; it is not a model/training objective hyperparameter

code_audit.create_b1k_data_loader_worker_effect: config.num_workers is passed to TorchDataLoader; batch size, seed, dataset construction, transforms, sharding, optimizer, model, and action horizon are not changed by this argument
code_audit.shuffle_generator: TorchDataLoader creates torch.Generator() and manual_seed(config.seed); sampler/shuffle ordering is driven by this generator rather than worker count
code_audit.worker_init_function_effect: only sets JAX/XLA allocator environment variables; it does not modify examples, labels, actions, or the scientific treatment
code_audit.num_workers_zero_semantics: the same TorchDataLoader executes dataset access in the main process and avoids spawned persistent workers

existing_zero_worker_evidence.scope_note: This prior smoke establishes that the frozen dataset/normalization can produce the required batch shape with zero workers. It is not a scientific outcome and is not used to choose a treatment.
